stories.title: Bills, Josh Allen outlast Rams in overtime on MNF
stories.summary: Using a throwback offense with downhill runs and scrambles from their star QB, the Bills escape with the win.

stories.title: Source: Dodgers' decision on Ohtani's status for G3 of NLCS hinges on health
stories.summary: The Dodgers will gauge whether Shohei Ohtani's lingering injuries warrant him sitting out but will keep playing him if he deems himself healthy, a source said.

stories.title: Rams OL Jackson punches Bills LB Chubb at midfield after 'emotional game'
stories.summary: On the field after the Los Angeles Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Buffalo Bills on Monday night, Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb in a scene captured by ESPN's cameras at SoFi Stadium.

stories.title: Bills' Allen, 0-7 in OT games entering MNF, finally gets over hump in wild win
stories.summary: Josh Allen came through with his usual late-game theatrics in leading the Bills to a 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on "Monday Night Football," breaking his careerlong winless streak in OT.

stories.title: Contreras powers Brewers to 2-0 NLCS lead, vows Milwaukee will 'keep going'
stories.summary: Getting to the Los Angeles bullpen in the later innings, the Milwaukee Brewers posted 12 hits, including 10 singles, in Game 2 on Monday, scoring four runs in the final four frames en route to a 7-4 win over the Dodgers to take a 2-0 series lead.
